import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def probe(request, policy, expected):
    request_before = copy.deepcopy(request)
    policy_before = copy.deepcopy(policy)
    actual = evaluate(request, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
    assert request == request_before
    assert policy == policy_before
    assert set(actual) == {'ok', 'records', 'errors'}
    assert all(set(x) == {'id', 'amount'} for x in actual['records'])
    assert all(set(x) == {'row', 'cause'} for x in actual['errors'])

policy = {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}
probe({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':0},{'id':'b','amount':2,'unit':'cm'}]}, policy, {'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':0},{'id':'b','amount':0.02}],'errors':[]})
probe({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':-1},{'id':'x','amount':2},{'id':'x','amount':3,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'x','amount':4},{'id':False,'amount':1}]}, policy, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'},{'row':3,'cause':'duplicate'},{'row':4,'cause':'id'}]})
probe({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'b','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'c','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'d','amount':1,'unit':[]}]}, policy, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'},{'row':3,'cause':'unit'}]})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: current_policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(request, current_policy) for request in requests]
print('boundary probes and report verification passed')
